rationale: Live reference-Pin collection (29 pins across 3 queries, 2026-09-08) shows generic 'tallow soap'/'handmade soap' search is dominated by DIY recipe/tutorial content, not finished-product buyers. The 'soap gifts' query instead surfaces real commercial-intent competitor listings -- most directly, hearthropic's 'Tallow Soap Gift Set' with a bamboo rack and bag. That is a near-exact positioning match for the real After the Harvest bar: reframe it as a gift-worthy, small-batch homestead item rather than competing in the recipe-saturated 'tallow soap' search. Combined with the standing video-format evidence (short vertical muted-first captioned video beats static), this points to the same production approach, retargeted with gift-forward copy and keyword.
